tournament.name: June OCC Clash Qualifier B
tournament.description:
OCC CLASH JUNE SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - June 10 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline June 10 @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline June 9)

  • The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season.

Round of 8 Finals - June 17 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline June 15 @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
